Got let go last month. Short call on a Wednesday, then my laptop logged me out of everything by lunch.

I'm looking for work. 47 applications so far, 11 replies. Most of them no.

Rejection email yesterday while I was at the grocery store, standing there with a cart full of stuff I didn't need. Harder part is doing the CV again every Sunday and writing cover letters like you're thrilled.

I cut the generic connect messages. Now I only reach out if I have a specific question about a team or a role. I also removed "Open to work" from my headline.
